questions.stem_text:
Which of the following characteristics is predicted for an early-successional plant
community?

options.C: High presence of fully matured plant species
options.E: High rates of soil nutrient depletion

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - High detrital biomass

questions.stem_text:
Mitochondria isolated and placed in a buffered solution with a low pH begin to manufacture
ATP. Which of the following is the best explanation for the effect of low external pH?

options.A: It increases the acid concentration in the mitochondria matrix.
options.B: It decreases the acid concentration in the mitochondria matrix.
options.C: It increases the concentration of H+ in the mitochondria matrix.
options.D: It decreases the OH- concentration in the mitochondria matrix.
options.E: It increases diffusion of H+ from the intermembrane space to the matrix.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - It increases diffusion of H+ from the intermembrane space to the matrix.

questions.stem_text:
In reference to a segment of DNA, which of the following molecules contains the fewest
number of nucleotides?

options.A: the tRNA transcript from the original DNA
options.B: a single strand of the original DNA segment after a substitution mutation
options.C: the final processed mRNA made from the original DNA
options.D: the primary RNA transcript (after splicing) from the original DNA
options.E: a single strand of the original DNA segment after a duplication mutation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the tRNA transcript from the original DNA

questions.stem_text: All of the following might be found in connective tissue EXCEPT
What properties of water make it an essential component of living matter?

options.A: Water is useful just because of its cooling properties.
options.B: Water is only important for hydration.
options.C: Water's role is limited to acting as a chemical reactant in cellular processes.
options.D: Water is important primarily because it contributes to the structural rigidity of cells.
options.E: Water's only function is to provide a medium for aquatic organisms.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Water is useful just because of its cooling properties.
